tool_signatures.name: get_passage
tool_signatures.description: Reads one passage in full by its ID, after search has found it. Use it when a search result was shortened, or when you need the text around a passage: neighbors adds up to 3 passages before and after it from the same page, in document order. Returns { passage, before, after }, each passage with its citation_url. To find passages, use search instead. Read-only; fails if the ID is unknown or its source was removed.

id.description: The id field of a passage from a search result. IDs stay stable across syncs.

neighbors.description: How many passages from the same page to include before and after it, in document order (0-3, default 0).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id field of a passage from a search result. IDs stay stable across syncs.

parameters.name: neighbors
parameters.description: How many passages from the same page to include before and after it, in document order (0-3, default 0).

tool_signatures.name: list_sources
tool_signatures.description: Lists the configured documentation sources: id, name, type, document and passage counts, and the last sync status. Use the ids to narrow search with source_ids. Sources are added and synced only from the citepath CLI, not through MCP. Read-only.

tool_signatures.name: search
tool_signatures.description: Start here: full-text search over the documentation indexed on this machine. Returns ranked passages, each with an id, title, heading path, citation_url, and text (long passages are shortened; read them in full with get_passage). Works with natural-language questions and code identifiers (getUserName, --dry-run, a.b.c). Results come from the current docs version; other_versions lists older versions that also matched, each with a path_prefix to pass back as path_prefix to search that version. Use list_sources to see which sources exist. Read-only.

query.description: What to look for: a question, keywords, or identifiers.

source_ids.description: Only search these source IDs, as returned by list_sources. Omit to search all sources.

path_prefix.description: Only passages whose URL (web sources) or root-relative path (local sources) starts with this prefix, for example a docs section or an other_versions path_prefix from a previous search.
